cashPaid.label: Cash paid
cashPaid.definition: Amounts actually paid, as recorded. Energy estimated for distance without drive data is included and always named.

economicCost.label: Economic cost
economicCost.definition: Costs spread over the period they cover instead of the day they were paid.

fullCost.label: Full cost
fullCost.definition: The economic cost plus depreciation: what owning the vehicle really costs.

runningCost.label: Running cost
runningCost.definition: Energy or fuel, tolls and parking only.

atTheWheel.label: Consumption at the wheel
atTheWheel.definition: Energy used while driving, as measured by the vehicle.

atThePlug.label: Consumption at the plug
atThePlug.definition: Energy drawn when charging, losses included, over the distance driven.

estimatedEnergy.label: Estimated energy
estimatedEnergy.definition: Energy priced for distance driven without drive data, from the vehicle average consumption and price.
